lines.en: label nikidate10:
I tap on Niki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Niki 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: It’s still early, so chances are she has enough time for her daily dose of wiener right now.
lines.zh: 现在还早，所以她多半还有空来上今天的那一根香肠。

lines.en: I’m not usually the type of guy to call up a girl just to give her some sausage, but Niki seems to really enjoy that sort of thing.
lines.zh: 我平时不是那种会打电话叫姑娘出来、就为了给她塞根香肠的男人，但 Niki 似乎真的很爱这一口。

lines.en: Besides, Kaori will be there as well. And nothing says bonding like two girls wrapping their lips around some meat together.
lines.zh: 再说了，Kaori 也会在。而没有什么比两个姑娘一起把嘴唇裹在同一块肉上更能增进感情的了。

lines.en: : What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你想干嘛？

lines.en: : Oh, you {i}know{/i} what I want.
lines.zh: : 哦，你{i}知道{/i}我想干嘛。

lines.en: : Ew, why are you talking like that? Stop it.
lines.zh: : 恶心，你干嘛用那种腔调说话？别这样。

lines.en: : Sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : Are you free right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在有空吗？

lines.en: : Depends.
lines.zh: : 看情况。

lines.en: : On?
lines.zh: : 看什么情况？

lines.en: : Whether or not {i}you’re{/i} free.
lines.zh: : 看{i}你{/i}有没有空。

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我有空。

lines.en: : Then I am not. Goodbye, [nikitemp].
lines.zh: : 那我就没空了。再见，[nikitemp]。

lines.en: : You fucking bitch.
lines.zh: : 你这婊子。

lines.en: : Hahah! I’m kidding, idiot.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！我开玩笑的，白痴。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can get away for an hour or two.
lines.zh: : 行吧，我能溜出来一两个小时。

lines.en: : But if you show up with my little sister, I swear to fucking God.
lines.zh: : 但你要是带着我妹妹一起出现，我对天发誓。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t worry. She’s still asleep in my bed. It was a really long night.
lines.zh: : 哦，别担心。她还睡在我床上呢。昨晚可真漫长。

lines.en: : You fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他——

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and laugh silently to myself as I get dressed.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，一边穿衣服一边无声地笑。

lines.en: And then I say goodbye to Noriko, who is still asleep in my bed following a very long night.
lines.zh: 然后我跟 Noriko 道别——在漫长的一夜之后，她还睡在我床上。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: scene nikidateten1
Kaori is able to go on break shortly after Niki and I make it to the diner and I move one step closer to watching her eat a wiener.
lines.zh: 我和 Niki 到餐厅后不久，Kaori 就得以休息一下，而我又离看她吃下一根香肠更近了一步。

lines.en: : Kaori.
lines.zh: : Kaori。

lines.en: : Yes, Ex-Boyfriendburger?
lines.zh: : 在，前男友汉堡？

lines.en: : I’m not your ex-boyfriend. I’m Niki’s.
lines.zh: : 我不是你前男友。我是 Niki 的。

lines.en: : What is a “Niki?”
lines.zh: : “Niki”是什么？

lines.en: : Sorry. I meant the cotton candy girl.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我是指那个棉花糖女孩。

lines.en: : You know, Kaori, you should probably think of adding more things to the menu soon. I feel like you’re missing out on a good amount of profit only selling one thing.
lines.zh: : 我说 Kaori，你大概该考虑往菜单上多加点东西了。只卖一样，我觉得你错过了不少利润。

lines.en: scene nikidateten2
: But you love the wiener!
lines.zh: : 可你爱死香肠了！

lines.en: : I {i}tolerate{/i} the wiener. It’s different. I’d much prefer something sweeter.
lines.zh: : 我是能{i}忍受{/i}香肠。这不一样。我更想要甜一点的东西。

lines.en: : Weird way to admit to being a lesbian, but I’m glad I could be here to witness it.
lines.zh: : 承认自己是拉拉的方式挺怪的，不过我很荣幸能在这儿亲眼见证。

lines.en: scene nikidateten3
: Shush.
: Did you just shush me?...
lines.zh: : 你刚才嘘我？……

lines.en: : What’s a “lesbian?”
lines.zh: : “拉拉”是什么？

lines.en: scene nikidateten4
: A lesbian is a girl who’s sexually attracted to other girls.
lines.zh: : 拉拉就是会对其他女孩子产生性趣的女孩子。

lines.en: : Is that not all girls?
lines.zh: : 那不是所有女孩子都这样吗？

lines.en: scene nikidateten5
: You like girls, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢女孩子，Kaori？

lines.en: : I like all people! Everyone is attractive in their own way! Even you!
lines.zh: : 我喜欢所有人！每个人都有各自迷人的地方！连你也是！

lines.en: : What do you mean, “even” me?
lines.zh: : 你说“连”我是什么意思？

lines.en: : I apologize for being hard to understand. But it seems that you still have your sights set on Friendburger, which means we can not be together!
lines.zh: : 抱歉我说话难懂。不过看来你依然心系朋友汉堡，这也就是说我们不可能在一起了！

lines.en: : Niki’s straight anyway, so she wouldn't want a relationship with you, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 再说了 Niki 是直女，她不会想跟你交往的，Kaori。

lines.en: scene nikidateten6
: What are you talking about? No I’m not.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？我可不是。

lines.en: : You’re not?
lines.zh: : 你不是？

lines.en: : You literally know this. We got into a fight over-
lines.zh: : 你明明知道的。我们还为此吵过——

lines.en: scene nikidateten7
: Oh, right. Your stupid memory sucks or whatever.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你那愚蠢的记忆烂透了什么的。

lines.en: I learned something today.
lines.zh: 今天我学到了点东西。

lines.en: : Do you see how the one made of aerated sugar did not deny her feelings for you? This must be love!
lines.zh: : 你瞧，那个充气糖做的姑娘并没有否认她对你的感情。这一定是爱！

lines.en: : Kiss!
lines.zh: : 亲一个！

lines.en: scene nikidateten8
: No, Kaori. I’m not going to kiss my stupid, asshole ex-boyfriend in a dirty old diner full of...dirt and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不要，Kaori。我才不要在这家又脏又旧的、到处都是……灰尘什么的餐厅里，亲我那个又蠢又混蛋的前男友。

lines.en: : I cleaned this table myself! You may kiss here whenever you like and I will explain to my manager that I can not stop love!
lines.zh: : 这张桌子可是我亲手擦的！你们想在这儿亲随时都可以，我会跟店长解释，说我阻止不了爱！

lines.en: scene nikidateten9
: Can I kiss you instead? You think I’m cute, right?
lines.zh: : 那我能亲你吗？你觉得我可爱，对吧？

lines.en: : Kissburger?!
lines.zh: : 亲亲汉堡？！

lines.en: : I know I’m probably supposed to be getting jealous or whatever, but I want to let the two of you know that I unconditionally support this development.
lines.zh: : 我知道这时候我大概该吃醋什么的，但我想让你们两个知道，我无条件支持这个发展。

lines.en: scene nikidateten10
: Ugh, great. So now I just sound like a slut. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 呃，好极了。这下我听着就像个荡妇了。谢了啊。

lines.en: : Slutburger...
lines.zh: : 荡妇汉堡……

lines.en: : Apologize to Kaori. You got her hopes up and now she has to learn what a slut is.
lines.zh: : 跟 Kaori 道歉。你让她燃起了希望，现在她还得去学“荡妇”是什么意思。

lines.en: scene nikidateten11
: I’m sorry for playing around, Kaori. I have a history of losing my head around this jerkburger and it often leads to me saying things in the heat of the moment.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我瞎闹了，Kaori。我一碰到这个混蛋汉堡就容易头脑发热，常常一上头就说出些不该说的话。

lines.en: scene nikidateten12
: Ah! Jerkburger!
lines.zh: : 啊！混蛋汉堡！

lines.en: : What? No. Don’t repeat things Niki says. She’s evil and steals clothing from people without realizing they only have two versions of the same shirt.
lines.zh: : 什么？不。别学 Niki 说话。她很邪恶，还会偷别人的衣服，全然不顾人家那件同款衬衫只有两件。

lines.en: : I’d like to say I still have a few of your hoodies from back when we dated, but I think I may have {i}accidentally{/i} dropped all of them into a fire. Whoops.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想说我们交往那会儿我还留着你的几件连帽衫，不过我觉得我可能{i}不小心{/i}把它们全丢进火里了。哎呀。

lines.en: : Wow. I really did a number on you, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 哇。我真把你伤得不轻啊，是吧？

lines.en: scene nikidateten13
: Haha! Yeah! You made me want to kill myself! Thanks!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！对啊！你害得我都想自杀了！谢了啊！

lines.en: : Uh-oh. This does not seem like a conversation that is friendly for the Mistress of the Dark to be involved with.
lines.zh: : 噢——噢。这场对话似乎不太适合黑暗女主人参与。

lines.en: : I have already informed both of you that I can not stop love. Please continue confessing your sad human feelings to one another while I go pretend to not listen from behind the counter.
lines.zh: : 我已经跟你们两个说过了，我阻止不了爱。请继续向彼此倾诉你们可悲的人类感情，我要去柜台后面假装没在听了。

lines.en: scene nikidateten14
: Wait, Kaori. You don’t have to leave. I was just-
lines.zh: : 等等，Kaori。你不用走。我只是——

lines.en: : Tell the burger about your feelings while I prepare for the wieners to come!
lines.zh: : 在我为香肠的到来做准备的时候，跟那个汉堡说说你的感情吧！

lines.en: : They are very big wieners, so it may take them longer to come than normal ones!
lines.zh: : 那些香肠非常大，所以它们可能要比普通香肠花更久才会「来」！

lines.en: : I think that’s a myth, actually. I have no trouble-
lines.zh: : 我觉得那其实是个谣言。我可一点困难都没——

lines.en: scene nikidateten15
: Only I can make your wiener come! Don’t you forget that!
lines.zh: : 只有我能让你的香肠「来」！你可别忘了！

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Thanks, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Kaori。

lines.en: : Hello!
lines.zh: : 你好！

lines.en: scene nikidateten16
Kaori storms off into the kitchen and trips over...something.
lines.zh: Kaori 一阵风似的冲进厨房，然后被……什么东西绊了一下。

lines.en: It’s probably nothing to worry about, though, since a few of the kitchen staff quickly come to her rescue and help her regain her footing before breaking into a fit of laughter.
lines.zh: 不过大概没什么好担心的，因为几个后厨的人很快赶过去救她，扶她重新站稳，随后爆出一阵大笑。

lines.en: It’s a little tough to remember that people have lives outside of me, but I guess Kaori and Niki are the two best examples of that I can think of.
lines.zh: 要记住别人在我之外也有自己的生活，是有点难；不过我想，Kaori 和 Niki 是我能想到的最好的两个例子。

lines.en: Both of them live to please others while I...live to please myself and various [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: 她们两个都为取悦别人而活，而我……为取悦自己和各种 [teenage]女孩而活。

lines.en: Just...in a different way.
lines.zh: 只是……方式不太一样。

lines.en: scene nikidateten17
: Why do I get the feeling you were thinking of something disgusting just now?
lines.zh: : 我怎么有种感觉，你刚才在想什么很恶心的事？

lines.en: : Probably a safe bet. I’m essentially always thinking of something disgusting.
lines.zh: : 大概是猜对了。我基本上无时无刻不在想什么很恶心的事。

lines.en: Niki takes off her disguise in preparation for the coming sausages and slides her glasses to the side of the table.
lines.zh: Niki 为即将到来的香肠脱下伪装，把眼镜推到桌子一侧。

lines.en: But instead of saying anything afterward, she just stares at me like she’s waiting for me to...apologize for my entire existence or something like that.
lines.zh: 可之后她什么也没说，只是盯着我，像在等我……为自己整个存在道歉什么的。

lines.en: I don’t really know what she wants.
lines.zh: 我真不知道她想要什么。

lines.en: That’s probably why our relationship ended.
lines.zh: 大概这就是我们分手的原因。

lines.en: I’m sure it had nothing to do with whatever tragedy that befell me.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，那跟降临在我身上的那场悲剧毫无关系。

lines.en: scene handsareweird
scene imissyoumore
scene dust5
scene nikidateten17
: So, about what happened at the beach.
lines.zh: : 那么，关于在海边发生的那件事。

lines.en: : What about it?
lines.zh: : 关于它什么？

lines.en: : Well...that was weird, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那挺奇怪的，对吧？

lines.en: : Which part? The one where I showed up? Or the one where I left before you woke up?
lines.zh: : 哪一部分？是我出现的那部分，还是我在你醒来之前就走了的那部分？

lines.en: : I guess both. I thought we were on a little worse terms than sleeping together.
lines.zh: : 大概两部分都是。我还以为我们的关系已经糟到不会上床了呢。

lines.en: : As much as we {i}should{/i} be on worse terms, I’m doing my best to not hold anything against you.
lines.zh: : 虽然我们本{i}该{/i}关系更糟，但我在努力不把任何事怪到你头上。

lines.en: scene nikidateten18
: I know things were really rough for you back then.
lines.zh: : 我知道那时候你日子很不好过。

lines.en: : I just wish you would have called or something and...you know, {i}not{/i} kept your childhood friend and first ever girlfriend waiting like a fucking lunatic.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望你能打个电话什么的……你知道的，{i}别{/i}让我这个青梅竹马兼初代女友像个疯子一样一直等下去。

lines.en: : I missed you a lot.
lines.zh: : 我很想你。

lines.en: : And like...I don’t know. I guess I still do or whatever.
lines.zh: : 而且……怎么说呢。我猜我现在还是想你，大概吧。

lines.en: : It’s starting to sound like I won’t be getting my shirt back.
lines.zh: : 听起来我那件衬衫是要不回来了。

lines.en: scene nikidateten19
: Will you shut up about the fucking shirt?! I’m trying to be serious here!
lines.zh: : 你能不能别再提那件该死的衬衫了？！我在认真说话呢！

lines.en: scene nikidateten18
: You know...I always said all this stuff to myself about what I would do if I actually {i}did{/i} bump into you again.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我以前总在心里排练，要是{i}真{/i}有一天再撞见你，我会怎么做。

lines.en: : And in every single made up scenario, I always had the upper hand.
lines.zh: : 而在每一个我编出来的场景里，占上风的永远是我。

lines.en: : I’d catch you in line for one of my concerts or see you in the mall during a signing event...and I’d laugh to myself and look the other way.
lines.zh: : 我会在我演唱会排队的人群里逮到你，或者在签售活动上在商场里看见你……然后我会在心里冷笑，把头扭开。

lines.en: : I wanted you to think that I forgot about you, like how {i}you{/i} forgot about me.
lines.zh: : 我想让{i}你{/i}以为我已经忘了你，就像你忘了我的那样。

lines.en: : Or...are {i}continuing{/i} to forget about me, because I still have no idea what this shit you’re trying to pull with your memory is.
lines.zh: : 或者……就像你正在{i}继续{/i}忘掉我一样，因为我到现在都搞不懂你这套记忆的把戏到底想玩什么。

lines.en: : But...as much as I hate to say it...I can’t do it.
lines.zh: : 可是……虽然我很不想承认……我做不到。

lines.en: : I can’t actually forget you.
lines.zh: : 我真的忘不掉你。

lines.en: : And...I don’t even think I want to anymore.
lines.zh: : 而且……我觉得我现在甚至不想忘掉了。

lines.en: : Which is why I made my driver turn around and take me back to the inn. And why I left in such a hurry that I didn’t even take my bag with me.
lines.zh: : 所以我才让司机掉头，把我送回那家旅馆。也所以我走的时候急得连包都没拿。

lines.en: : You were that excited to see me?
lines.zh: : 你当时那么想见我？

lines.en: scene nikidateten20
: You know, there are thousands, if not millions of other guys who would be creaming their pants if they were in your position right now.
lines.zh: : 你要知道，现在处在你的位置上、能爽到裤子都湿了的男人，少说有几千个，多说有几百万个。

lines.en: : Do you...do you want me to ejaculate?
lines.zh: : 你……你想让我射出来吗？

lines.en: scene nikidateten21
: {i}What?{/i}
: You just sounded a little disappointed that I’m not freaking out about this.
lines.zh: : 你刚才听起来有点失望，因为我没为此抓狂。

lines.en: scene nikidateten22
: Because I am! I hate that {i}I’m{/i} the one crawling back when I spent years and years and years preparing myself to do the opposite!
lines.zh: : 因为我抓狂啊！{i}我{/i}恨死了，明明我花了一年又一年、一年又一年地准备做相反的事，结果爬回来的却是我！

lines.en: : You're not saying you want to get back together, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是在说你想复合吧？

lines.en: scene nikidateten23
: No...I don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 不……我觉得不是。

lines.en: : I don’t really know what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道自己在说什么。

lines.en: : I {i}can’t{/i} have a boyfriend because of my job. But I also don’t really want you running off and settling down with anyone either.
lines.zh: : 因为工作的关系，我{i}不能{/i}有男朋友。可我也不太想让你跑掉、跟别的什么人安定下来。

lines.en: : Well...you definitely don’t have to worry about that. I’m not really the “settling” type.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你完全不用担心那个。我真不是“安定”那一型的。

lines.en: : No...you never were...
lines.zh: : 是啊……你从来都不是……

lines.en: : Hey.
: You’re not...
lines.zh: : 你该不会……

lines.en: : Still a virgin, are you?...
lines.zh: : 还是处女吧？……

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : Since we...you know. Never really did it.
lines.zh: : 因为那次我们……你知道的。其实没真的做成。

lines.en: : You...
: Mhm.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : But not because I can’t find anyone. I’m famous and I can have whoever I want.
lines.zh: : 但不是因为我找不到人。我可是名人，我想要谁就有谁。

lines.en: : I was just...never interested in anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我只是……从来没有对别人感兴趣过。

lines.en: : You are a world-famous idol who is about to turn thirty...and is still a virgin?
lines.zh: : 你是个世界知名的偶像，马上就要三十岁了……却还是处女？

lines.en: scene nikidateten24
: What does my age have to do with it?! There’s nothing wrong with being a virgin at thirty!
lines.zh: : 我的年纪跟这有什么关系？！三十岁还是处女一点问题都没有！

lines.en: : In fact, there are tons of people who go even longer than that!
lines.zh: : 事实上，比这更久的大有人在！

lines.en: : And you’d probably be surprised to hear that some of them may be listening in on this conversation right now!
lines.zh: : 而且你要是知道，他们当中说不定有人此刻正在偷听这段对话，你大概会吓一跳！

lines.en: : I’m sorry if this sounds insensitive, but...we really never had sex?
lines.zh: : 很抱歉我这话听起来有点不近人情，不过……我们真的从来没有做过？

lines.en: scene nikidateten25
: We just did...{i}hand{/i} stuff most of the time.
lines.zh: : 我们……大部分时候只做了{i}用手{/i}的那些。

lines.en: : It was hard since my parents and Noriko were always home...
lines.zh: : 毕竟那时候我爸妈和 Noriko 总在家，很难有机会……

lines.en: : And, believe it or not, you were really understanding about that sort of thing back then. You never pushed me to really {i}do{/i} it, you know?
lines.zh: : 而且信不信由你，那时候你在这类事上真的很体贴。你从来没有逼我真正去{i}做{/i}，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Jesus, why are we even talking about this in a diner? What has my life become?
lines.zh: : 老天，我们干嘛要在餐厅里聊这个？我的人生到底变成什么样了？

lines.en: : Niki, I-
lines.zh: : Niki，我——

lines.en: : I changed my mind. I don’t want to hear it.
lines.zh: : 我改主意了。我不想听。

lines.en: : You can keep whatever you’ve done these last eight years to yourself. I don’t want to know.
lines.zh: : 你过去八年干了什么，你自己留着就行。我不想知道。

lines.en: : I’ll just fill in the blanks with how I want things to be and force myself to believe they’re true.
lines.zh: : 我就按我希望的样子把那些空白填满，然后强迫自己相信那是真的。

lines.en: : Is that really how you want to live? By just pretending things are better than they actually are?
lines.zh: : 你真的想这么活吗？就靠假装一切比实际更好？

lines.en: : Gee, wonder who I learned that from?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你猜我是跟谁学的？

lines.en: : I don’t have a problem with it. I’m just surprised to be seeing this side of you when it still seems like you can’t stand being around me half the time.
lines.zh: : 我对此没意见。我只是很意外会看到你这一面，毕竟你看起来有一半的时间都受不了跟我在一起。

lines.en: : Trust me, this is even weirder for me than it is for you.
lines.zh: : 相信我，这事对我来说比对你还奇怪。

lines.en: : God. None of this ever would have happened if I didn’t bump into you and Noriko at that damn beach. My mind has not stopped being fucking...annoying since then.
lines.zh: : 天哪。要是我没在那该死的海边撞见你和 Noriko，这一切根本不会发生。从那以后，我的脑子就没停止过他妈的……烦人。

lines.en: : Do you think something is actually happening between Noriko and me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我和 Noriko 之间真的在发生什么吗？

lines.en: : I think...that Noriko likes you way more than she should. And I think you’re exactly the type to take that affection and run with it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……Noriko 喜欢你，喜欢得远远超过了应有的程度。而我觉得你正是那种会把这份好感拿着就跑的人。

lines.en: : It seems like you’ve always been trying to fill some sort of hole inside of you, and I don’t really know who else is there to do that right now.
lines.zh: : 你好像一直在试图填满自己心里的某个洞，而我真不知道现在还有谁能替你填。

lines.en: : So...I don’t know. Keep me in your thoughts and don’t fuck my sister, I guess?
lines.zh: : 所以……我不知道。心里记着我一点，还有别操我妹妹，大概吧？

lines.en: scene nikidateten26
: Like, really. Please don’t fuck my sister.
lines.zh: : 说真的。求你别操我妹妹。

lines.en: scene nikidateten24
: Jesus Christ! Repeat after me! You! Will! Not! Fuck! My! Sister!
lines.zh: : 我的天啊！跟我念！你！不！准！操！我！妹！妹！

lines.en: : You. Will. Not-
lines.zh: : 你。不准——

lines.en: : Not “You!”
lines.zh: : 不是“你！”

lines.en: : “I will not fuck your sister!”
lines.zh: : 是“我不会操你妹妹！”

lines.en: : Thank you for making that promise, Niki. But I don’t have a sister for you to fuck no matter {i}how{/i} much you want to.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你做出这个承诺，Niki。不过不管你{i}多{/i}想操，我都没有妹妹给你操。

lines.en: scene nikidateten27
: Okay, you know what? This was clearly a mistake.
lines.zh: : 行吧，你知道吗？这显然是个错误。

lines.en: : I thought it might be a sign that I wanted to start patching things up when I came to you in the middle of the night, but I can see now that you’re just going to be a prick about it.
lines.zh: : 我半夜去找你的时候，还以为那是个信号，说明我想开始修补关系；可我现在看明白了，你只会在这件事上当个混蛋。

lines.en: : I need you to look at things from my perspective, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我需要你站在我的角度看一看。

lines.en: : You showed up in the middle of the night, stole one of my shirts, and then left before-
lines.zh: : 你半夜找上门，偷了我一件衬衫，然后在——

lines.en: scene nikidateten24
: Oh my fucking God! I will literally buy you a new shirt! Just shut the fuck up about it!
lines.zh: : 我操！我真的会给你买件新衬衫！你他妈能不能别再提了！

lines.en: : Incoming wieners! Brace for impact and massive girth!
lines.zh: : 香肠来了！准备迎接冲击和巨大的围度吧！

lines.en: scene nikidateten28
: Hah...
: Wait, we didn’t even order-
lines.zh: : 等等，我们根本没点——

lines.en: : You did not have to, Jerkyexboyfriendburger! We only have one thing on the menu!
lines.zh: : 你们不用点，混蛋前男友汉堡！我们菜单上只有一样东西！

lines.en: : Didn't you read it? All we have is the sausage fest!
lines.zh: : 你们没看菜单吗？我们只有香肠盛宴！

lines.en: : Seriously! That’s it!
lines.zh: : 真的！就这个！

lines.en: : We read the fucking menu, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 我们看了那该死的菜单，Kaori。

lines.en: : Congratulations! I am very proud of your ability to comprehend words! Good job!
lines.zh: : 恭喜！我真为你们理解文字的能力感到骄傲！干得好！

lines.en: scene nikidateten29
: So, now what?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来怎么办？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I figure that if you want to start patching things up, we can-
lines.zh: : 我想，如果你想开始修补关系，我们可以——

lines.en: : Not about our fucking relationship. About all this food.
lines.zh: : 不是说我们该死的关系。是说这堆食物。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, I’m not hungry.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，我不饿。

lines.en: : Remind me again why we keep coming here if you literally never eat anything?
lines.zh: : 再提醒我一下，既然你从来什么都没吃过，我们为什么还一直来这儿？

lines.en: : That’s easy, Niki.
lines.zh: : 这很简单，Niki。

lines.en: scene black
: Because if there is anyone who deserves a good wiener, it’s a twenty-nine year old virgin.
lines.zh: : 因为如果要说有谁配得上一根好香肠，那就是一个二十九岁的处女。

lines.en: : I fucking hate you.
lines.zh: : 我他妈恨死你了。
